discovered: The sandbox this ran in was checked out on a harness branch at c6870b1 with 173 tests, not the trunk; the brief's branch had to be fetched first. c6870b1 is an ancestor of 1ea0b99, so no history conflict.
FiSnapshot is a frozen dataclass: tests that want a variant must use dataclasses.replace, not attribute assignment.
tile.openstreetmap.org and fonts.googleapis.com are both blocked from this sandbox (proxy 403). Screenshots show system fonts and a grey map; the dark-map filter cannot be judged on real tiles here.
Global Playwright 1.56 (NODE_PATH=/opt/node22/lib/node_modules) drives the pre-installed Chromium without any install; Python playwright is absent.
The old idle_stop_seconds=5.0 was never passed by create_app, so no setting could have changed it before tonight.
The security-review skill diffs against origin/HEAD, which an unset clone lacks; pointing that symbolic ref at the branch's pushed tip scopes the review to the session.
decisions: The cutoff row states a date ('Available 17 Sep'), not a distance or monthly figure: distance is untrusted and the monthly stat is withheld by the same cutoff. Reversible, flagged for Chris.
/settings renders with no header rather than as a third tab: the toggle's design is two destinations; the revert is one line (tab='settings').
Camera idle default 120 s and reopen cooldown 2 s; the LED staying on for two minutes is the accepted cost. Explicitly NOT claimed as a black-screen fix.
The dark-map filter is proposed with a synthetic prototype, not shipped: the brief said screenshot it rather than assume, and only a real tile can settle it.
The harness branch claude/elegant-sagan-tit1xp-wu5zdk is kept identical to the trunk and marked safe to delete; all real work is on the trunk as Chris asked.
lessons: Verify the checkout matches the handoff before the tests: the sandbox was on a different branch with a different test count, and the brief's own instruction to stop on mismatch is what caught it.
A timing assertion in a hub test needs ~50 ms of slack for Windows' 16 ms clock; write it once, not after the Windows leg goes red.
For UI work the crafted-snapshot demo server (scratchpad serve_demo.py) plus global Playwright is a ten-minute path to real screenshots; it is worth keeping the pattern.
